full_description: In the KitchenS scene (no sink or microwave), the stove is already on. Raw food starts on a chopping board. Put the food into the pan, cook while watching the pie timer (green then yellow at the food's ideal doneness), then turn the stove knob off so the timer stops. Success is adequate doneness after the stove is off; leave the food in the pan.
